joanne (support): Hey team, escalating: customer ACME-42 reports console analytics showing TTFT windows completely missing for a subset of their deployments and tokens/sec toggling negative in the live streaming chart. They've got billing spikes and are pretty unhappy. :worried:

matt (eng-runtime): Ugh. Any repro steps or cluster/region info?

joanne (support): Happened after a forwarder restart in us-west-2 around 01:12 UTC. Affected streams: acme-42-prod-{a,b,c}. Attached sample query they ran: `SELECT window_start, sum(tokens) as tokensec FROM stream_rollup WHERE customer_id='acme-42' AND window_start > now() - interval '6 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;` result shows negative tokensec for some windows and null TTFT for others.

matt (eng-runtime): Can you paste the actual rows for one bad window? Need raw values (ingest_count, drop_count, first_token_latency).

joanne (support): pasted clip from the console: `2026-03-16T01:15Z | ingest: 1200 | drop: 1300 | tokensec: -100 | first_token_ms: NULL` — so drop > ingest in that window.

alejandra (eng-ml): If drop > ingest that implies the rollup consumer may have reprocessed an earlier checkpoint or double-submitted deltas with negative sign. Could be an at-least-once consumer reordering after a rebalance. Any recent deploys to the forwarder or rollup service?

samir (product): We didn't push changes to the rollup service, but we did rotate the Kafka consumer group on the forwarder for a security patch at ~01:10 UTC.

matt (eng-runtime): That matches. Hypothesis: forwarder restart + transient reassign caused duplicate negative deltas to be applied when window snapshots were compacted incorrectly. Two mitigations: 1) Backfill fix to re-run rollups for affected windows; 2) Patch forwarder to clamp tokensec >= 0 on write and treat NULL TTFT as NaN in charts (don't hide window entirely). Which do we want as hotfix?

joanne (support): Customer wants quick visible fix to stop billing noise and restore charts. Backfill sounds slower but more correct; clamp would stop negatives immediately. They asked for ETA.

matt (eng-runtime): Plan: immediate patch to the forwarder/transform pipeline to clamp tokensec: `tokensec = greatest(tokensec, 0)` before emit; and ensure we write an explicit sentinel for missing first-token time instead of NULL so charts show "delayed" not blank. That should reduce noise within 10-15m after deploy. Then schedule backfill for the 2-hour window to re-aggregate using committed offsets.

alejandra (eng-ml): One more thought: If KV cache TTLs and prefix caching combine with replayed negative deltas, clamp alone could hide a real regression in cost. We should tag clamped records with metadata so downstream billing can exclude them from invoicing until backfill completes. Add header `x-rollup-clamped: true` to those rows.

matt (eng-runtime): Agreed. I'll push a quick patch to forwarder: snippet below. Deploy to canary in us-west-2 then promote.

matt (eng-runtime): ```
-- forwarder transform pseudocode
function transform(row) {
  // ensure we never emit negative token delta
  row.tokensec = Math.max(0, row.tokensec);
  if (row.first_token_ms == null) row.first_token_ms = -1; // sentinel for charting
  row.headers = row.headers || {};
  if (original_tokensec < 0) row.headers['x-rollup-clamped'] = 'true';
  emit(row);
}
```

joanne (support): ETA from customer: wants confirmation in 30m or they'll escalate to account mgmt.

matt (eng-runtime): Kicking canary now. Canary will route ~3% of traffic for 5m. Watchlist: republish rate, consumer lag, any duplicates in rollup logs. Will post CI/CD link. :eyes:

sre-bot: deploy/forwarder-canary: started by matt — https://ci.internal/redwood/deploy/12345

alejandra (eng-ml): While canary runs, I'll prepare the backfill plan. Query to identify bad windows: `SELECT window_start, sum(ingest) as ingest, sum(drop) as drop FROM stream_rollup_raw WHERE customer_id='acme-42' AND window_start >= '2026-03-16 00:00' GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(drop) > sum(ingest);` We'll re-aggregate those windows from `stream_rollup_raw` using idempotent reducer.

matt (eng-runtime): Canary successful after 7m, no new negative tokensec emitted for canary group. Promoting to us-west-2 fleet. Rollout ETA 12m to full region.

sre-bot: deploy/forwarder: succeeded — https://ci.internal/redwood/deploy/12346

joanne (support): Pinging ACME-42: patch is live in us-west-2. Asking them to check billing dashboard and token/sec chart.

acme-ops (external): Confirmed: charts no longer show negative spikes, TTFT placeholder now shows "delayed" for the affected windows. Billing alert stopped. Thanks. :relieved:

alejandra (eng-ml): Starting backfill job now for affected windows 00:00-03:00 UTC. Backfill will write to a `rollup-repair` table first; we'll run diff to verify before applying to live. ETA 45m.

matt (eng-runtime): Note for postmortem: fix should include stronger consumer checkpointing and idempotent delta ingestion on rollup pipeline. Also add alerting for drop>ingest or tokensec<0 so SRE/support are paged before customers notice.

samir (product): Filing a PM action: track this in roadmap for rollup resiliency. Need UI change to show sentinel TTFT properly and not auto-hide windows.

joanne (support): Marking resolved for now since customer confirmed. Will leave thread open until backfill diff completed. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
